expectedText: I have an appointment at a community clinic next week. Before I go, I will write down the symptom I want to describe and the time I first noticed it. At reception, I will check my name and phone number. If I have a question about an allergy, I will put it on the same card. I might also ask a nurse what an examination involves. If a prescription has a word I do not understand, I can ask the pharmacy to explain the label. I will listen to the professional and take notes instead of guessing. My friend will wait outside, and I will send a message when the conversation is finished.
